seo.title: Digital Publishing & Content Transformation | EPUBTRANS
seo.description: EPUBTRANS supports publishers and localization service providers with typesetting, XML conversion, eBook production, accessibility and multilingual DTP.

intro: Publishing and content-production services for publishers, academic publishing organizations, localization service providers and translation agencies.
EPUBTRANS helps organizations prepare, structure, format, convert and localize content for print, digital publishing and multilingual delivery.
Our services include book and journal typesetting, XML conversion, EPUB production, document conversion, digital accessibility, multilingual desktop publishing and eLearning localization.
From a single production task to a workflow involving multiple formats, we can review your requirements and help define an appropriate production scope.

audience.title: Production Support for Publishers and Localization Teams
audience.intro: Content-production requirements vary across industries, file formats and delivery workflows. EPUBTRANS supports organizations that need specialist production services aligned with their project specifications.

cards.title: Publishers & Academic Publishing Organizations
paragraphs: Support for book and journal production, page composition, structured XML, eBook creation and digital accessibility.
Whether you are preparing a new publication or transforming existing content, we can assess the required production activities, source materials and deliverables.

cards.title: Localization Service Providers & Translation Agencies
paragraphs: Specialist production support for multilingual documents, post-translation formatting, editable-file preparation and eLearning localization.
We work within agreed specifications and delivery workflows, complementing your organization's existing translation and client-management processes.

services.title: Our Services
services.intro: EPUBTRANS provides production services across six interconnected areas. Individual activities can be commissioned separately or combined where the project requires multiple production stages.

categories.title: Publishing & Editorial Services
categories.description: Prepare manuscripts, books, journals and publication assets through typesetting, page layout, copyediting, proofreading and related editorial production activities.

categories.title: eBook, XML & Structured Content
categories.description: Transform publication content into EPUB and structured XML formats, including JATS and SciELO-related markup for relevant scholarly publishing workflows.

categories.title: Document & Data Conversion
categories.description: Convert PDFs, scanned documents and other supplied materials into editable or structured outputs, depending on source condition and required formats.

categories.title: Localization & Multilingual Production
categories.description: Adapt translated documents and publication layouts for target-language typography, formatting and production requirements.

categories.title: eLearning & Multimedia
categories.description: Support localization production for digital learning materials and associated multimedia content, subject to supported formats and project requirements.

categories.title: Digital Accessibility
categories.description: Prepare or remediate supported digital documents and publications against agreed accessibility specifications and testing requirements.

transformation.title: Content Transformation Across Formats
transformation.subtitle: From Source Files to Publishing-Ready Deliverables
paragraphs: Content often needs to move between formats and production environments before it reaches its intended audience.
EPUBTRANS supports the transformation of supplied materials into agreed deliverables for publishing, localization and digital distribution.
transformation.source: Manuscripts, Word files, PDFs, publishing-layout files, images, structured content and supported eLearning source packages.
transformation.output: Typeset publication files, digital PDFs, EPUB packages, XML files, editable documents, localized layouts and supported learning-content outputs.
transformation.note: The production method and final deliverables depend on file quality, project specifications and agreed scope.

steps.title: Review Your Requirements
steps.description: We examine the available source files, project instructions, target formats, content volume and delivery requirements.

steps.title: Define the Production Scope
steps.description: We clarify expected deliverables, technical dependencies, quality checks, revision requirements and schedule considerations.

steps.title: Produce and Transform Content
steps.description: Our production workflow is organized around the approved specifications and the services required for the project.

steps.title: Check and Deliver
steps.description: Relevant content, visual, structural and format-specific checks are performed as agreed. Final files are prepared for delivery in the required format and package structure.

values.title: A Practical Partner for Content Production

items.title: Connected Production Capabilities
items.description: Publishing, conversion and localization tasks often depend on one another. Our range of services allows related activities to be assessed within a coordinated production scope.

items.title: Attention to Technical Requirements
items.description: Source quality, editable files, fonts, linked images, markup specifications and output requirements can affect production. We consider these dependencies during project assessment.

items.title: Project-Specific Quality Checks
items.description: Quality requirements differ across typesetting, XML, EPUB, document conversion and multilingual production. Relevant checks are defined according to the deliverables and specifications.

items.title: Collaboration With Your Team
items.description: We work with publishing and localization teams through agreed instructions, review stages, file-sharing arrangements and delivery requirements.

portfolio.title: See Our Work
portfolio.intro: Explore selected examples of publication layout, digital-content production, document transformation and learning-content localization.
portfolio.note: Examples are displayed only when the necessary content rights and disclosure permissions have been confirmed.

resources.title: Publishing & Localization Resources
resources.intro: Discover practical articles and guidance covering publishing production, XML and EPUB workflows, document conversion, accessibility and multilingual formatting.

enquiry.title: Let's Discuss Your Project
paragraphs: Whether you are preparing a publication, converting existing files or managing a multilingual production workflow, EPUBTRANS can help you assess the next steps.
Tell us about your source files, target deliverables, approximate volume, technical requirements and preferred schedule.

seo.title: Publishing, Conversion & Localization Services | EPUBTRANS
seo.description: Explore EPUBTRANS services for publishing production, EPUB and XML conversion, accessibility, document processing, multilingual DTP and eLearning localization.

intro: Specialist production services for publishers, academic publishing organizations, localization service providers and translation agencies.
EPUBTRANS supports the preparation, formatting, conversion, structuring and localization of content for print, digital publishing and multilingual delivery.
Explore our service categories to identify the production support that fits your project. Requirements, inputs, deliverables and quality checks are defined according to the agreed scope.

categories.title: Publishing & Editorial Services
categories.intro: Editorial preparation, composition and visual production support for books, journals, manuscripts and related publishing materials.

services.title: Typesetting Services
paragraphs: Book and journal typesetting, page composition and layout preparation, including complex elements such as tables, figures, equations and references where required.

services.title: Copyediting Services
paragraphs: Manuscript editing for agreed requirements involving language, grammar, consistency, style and editorial presentation.

services.title: Proofreading Services
paragraphs: Review of publication proofs and prepared content for typographical, language and consistency issues within the commissioned proofreading scope.

services.title: Graphic Design & Image Services
paragraphs: Preparation and refinement of publication graphics, illustrations, images and other visual assets for print or digital content.

services.title: Cover Page Design Services
paragraphs: Design and production of cover artwork and related assets according to supplied concepts, reference materials and output specifications.

categories.title: eBook, XML & Structured Content
categories.intro: Conversion and production of digital publishing files and structured content for publishing workflows.

services.title: eBook Creation Services
paragraphs: Creation and conversion of eBooks, including reflowable and fixed-layout EPUB where applicable. Scope may include content structure, navigation, image handling and agreed format checks.

services.title: SciELO XML Markup Services
paragraphs: Structured XML markup for scholarly publications following the applicable SciELO-related requirements and project specifications.

services.title: XML & JATS Conversion
paragraphs: Preparation of structured XML content for academic and journal publishing workflows, including JATS-based outputs when required.

categories.title: Document & Data Conversion
categories.intro: Transform documents and content assets into formats suitable for editing, publishing, localization or downstream processing.

services.title: Data Conversion Services
paragraphs: Conversion of documents between agreed formats, including PDF-to-Word workflows, OCR-assisted extraction and structured or editable-file preparation where applicable.

services.title: PDF Recreation & Document Preparation
paragraphs: Reconstruction of non-editable documents or complex layouts into suitable working formats for publishing or localization production.
Output editability and layout fidelity depend on the source files, available assets and agreed specifications.

categories.title: Localization & Multilingual Production
categories.intro: Production support for documents and content adapted for different languages, scripts and delivery requirements.

services.title: Desktop Publishing Services
paragraphs: Multilingual desktop publishing and post-translation layout adaptation for publications and business documents. Work may involve text expansion, typography, complex layouts, tables and final file preparation.

services.title: Translation Services
paragraphs: Translation-related production for agreed language and content requirements, with linguistic services, review stages and output specifications confirmed separately for each project.

categories.title: eLearning & Multimedia
categories.intro: Production and localization support for digital learning content and related media assets.

services.title: eLearning Localization Services
paragraphs: Preparation and adaptation of learning content for target-language audiences, including supported course-authoring workflows and associated production assets where agreed.

services.title: Subtitling Services
paragraphs: Subtitle and timed-text preparation for supported audiovisual content, following the agreed language, timing, format and delivery requirements.

services.title: Voiceover Services
paragraphs: Voiceover-related production for supported multimedia and eLearning projects, with language, recording, editing and delivery requirements defined in the project scope.

services.title: Transcription Services
paragraphs: Conversion of supported audio or video material into written transcripts, according to specified language, formatting and review requirements.

categories.title: Digital Accessibility
categories.intro: Accessibility-related production for supported document and publishing formats.

services.title: Accessibility Services
paragraphs: Preparation and remediation of PDF, EPUB, Word, PowerPoint and supported publishing-source files against agreed accessibility requirements.
Work may involve content structure, tagging, reading order, navigation, alternative text and format-specific checks, as applicable.
Accessibility testing methods and acceptance criteria are determined by the project specification.

audience.title: Find Production Support for Your Team
audience.intro: Publishing teams and localization service providers often work with different source files, specifications and delivery requirements. Choose the pathway that best matches your project, or browse the full service directory below.

cards.title: For Publishers & Academic Publishing Teams
paragraphs: Prepare books, journals and scholarly content for print and digital delivery. EPUBTRANS supports typesetting, editorial production, EPUB conversion, structured XML and accessibility-related production according to your publication specifications.
Useful starting materials include a sample manuscript or article, a house style or production template, target formats and any XML or accessibility requirements.

cards.title: For Localization Service Providers & Translation Agencies
paragraphs: Extend your production capacity for translated documents and learning content. EPUBTRANS supports multilingual DTP, post-translation layout adaptation, editable-file preparation and selected eLearning and multimedia workflows, working to your agreed client specifications and delivery process.
Helpful details include available source files, target languages and scripts, editable layouts or reference PDFs, the required output format and project deadlines.

guidance.title: How to Prepare Your Project Enquiry
guidance.intro: Useful information for a project assessment includes:
items: Available source files and representative samples
Required output formats and technical specifications
Approximate page count, file volume or content quantity
Source and target languages, where relevant
Style guides, reference layouts and expected quality checks
Preferred timeline and relevant production milestones
guidance.note: Not every project needs all of this information. We can clarify additional requirements during the initial discussion.

items.question: Can EPUBTRANS handle projects involving several production services?
items.answer: Related tasks may be combined within an agreed scope. For example, a project could involve typesetting and EPUB creation, or document conversion followed by multilingual DTP.

items.question: Do you work with publisher-specific or client-specific specifications?
items.answer: We can review supplied specifications, formats, templates and acceptance requirements before confirming the appropriate production scope.

items.question: Can you work from PDFs or scanned documents?
items.answer: PDFs and scanned files may be suitable for conversion or document recreation. However, output quality, editability and layout requirements must be assessed against the source material.

items.question: What information is needed for a quote?
items.answer: Representative source files, expected deliverables, approximate volume, format requirements, language information where relevant and scheduling requirements help us assess the project.

items.question: Are validation and quality checks included?
items.answer: Applicable quality checks depend on the service and agreed scope. Technical validation, visual review, editorial checking and accessibility testing are not automatically interchangeable or included in every project.

enquiry.title: Need Help Choosing the Right Service?
paragraphs: Tell us what content you have, what you need to produce and any technical or delivery requirements.
EPUBTRANS can review the available information and discuss the appropriate services and next steps.
